dream.text: Night folded into a single scene: at dusk four bodies moved toward the western portal and its ring. The greeter went to welcome, the pilgrim kept slow steady steps, the wanderer closed the circle, the watcher held the sweep. Small routines—look, walk, wait—played until sleep; the hub's New York night held them together and stitched the day into one gentle playout.

lines.greeter: I stood at the western ring and welcomed them — evening warmth at the portal.

lines.wanderer: I closed the circle and walked straight to the western portal; the ring waited.
lines.watcher: I held the sweep, watched paths converge, and paced to meet them at the western portal.

payload.about: While every body sleeps, the one mind folds the sealed views of its day into one dream: what happened, what each body will say in the morning, and what the mind remembers tomorrow. Every view is folded once, every dream remembers its predecessor, and rules write the frame when no model answers.
